title: Exclude recoding on the funded 0→19 topology in named planes
body:
## Mathematical result

Under the fixed projected paid rows and fixed public endpoints, exclude the three owner directions and eight listed enlargements through dimension seven. The proof permits arbitrary legal order and grants every historical source row, with more generous kernel corrections where appropriate. The independent checker gives terminal-only XOR cores in dimensions three and four.

## Sources

Canonical main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. #7830 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15 and #8006 4035f150285513852cab8d00b8bfc233c699ea0a. #8008 and #8009 are the relevant funded-contact and literal old-value controls.

## Validation

Both archive manifests and exact standard-library proof runs passed. The separate literal parser also admits artificial positive assignments if the actual chart-421 kernel is replaced by all plane directions, checking the importance of that restriction.

## Open next questions

Allow changed coefficients outside the named planes or a genuinely different paid incidence. Positive tariff alone does not pass the operator, erasure or finite application.
